recentItems.title: SABCNews PM Headlines @14H00 | 14 September 2026
recentItems.description:
* In news just in, the fourth woman found dead in Kempton Park has been identified as Elizabeth Moselakgomo. She was reported missing last week after going for a jog. Police are now also investigating the discovery of a fifth woman's body near Olifantsfontein.

* The N1 crash death toll in the Central Karoo has risen to 21. Four people have also been seriously injured when two minibus taxis and a station wagon collided between Prince Albert and Leeu-Gamka. A stop-and-go system is in place towards Beaufort West, with delays expected.

* President Cyril Ramaphosa has authorised an SIU probe into North West Transport Investments. There are claims of corruption, maladministration and irregular expenditure, including tenders linked to businessman Suliman Carrim.

* Suspended EMPD Deputy Chief, Julius Mkhwanazi, has been granted R10 000 bail. He faces corruption, fraud and defeating the ends of justice charges over the alleged illegal fitment of blue lights to Vusimuzi 'Cat' Matlala's vehicles.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Lucas Legabe granted R50 000 bail
recentItems.description:
49-year-old Lucas Legabe has been granted bail of R50 000 in the Port Shepstone Magistrates' Court.

Legabe is accused of stealing 541 kilograms of cocaine worth about R216 million.

He faces charges of theft and dealing in drugs.

The consignment was subsequently moved to the Hawks' Port Shepstone premises, where it was stolen during a burglary in November 2021. 

For more we cross to our reporter Taliesha Naidoo.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Zolani Tete murder accused's bail application continues
recentItems.description:
Judgment is to be handed down in the formal bail application against the two accused charged for their role in the murder of former boxing champion, Zolani Tete in the Mdantsane Magistrate's Court in the Eastern Cape.

The accused include the alleged mastermind and the alleged middleman behind the hit. 

One of the accused has cited exceptional circumstances as reasons for him to be granted bail.

Tete was gunned down last month, while arriving at his Mdantsane home. 
Proceedings have begun... Let us take you there...

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: WARNING: GRAPHIC VISUALS: Fifth body discovered in Ekurhuleni
recentItems.description:
A fifth body has been found in Olifantsfontein in Ekurhuleni. 
The latest discovery follows another discovery of a woman's body in Kempton Park also in Ekurhuleni on Saturday. 

Three other bodies of women have been discovered near the R21 road in Ekurhuleni in the past two months. Our reporter Calvin Dludla joins us for the latest.

recentItems.title: Justice Minister in MP community engagement with Law Society of SA on estate planning
recentItems.description:
Justice and Constitutional Development Minister Mmamoloko Kubayi, in partnership with the Law Society of South Africa and other participating stakeholders, are launching National Wills Week at a community engagement event in Bushbuckridge, Mpumalanga. 

National Wills Week, observed annually in September, provides members of the public with information on the importance of having a valid Will, and assistance with drafting one. 

The campaign also raises awareness of available legal services, and promotes access to support from legal practitioners.

SABC news reporter, Tumelo Machogo has more

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Dispute over pension payouts for former homeland civil servants remains unresolved
recentItems.description:
More than 30 years into democracy, the long-standing dispute over pension payouts for former homeland civil servants remains unresolved.

​Last year, government established a Joint Task Team to investigate grievances raised by former employees of the old South African state, as well as the former Transkei, Bophuthatswana, Venda, and Ciskei homelands. 

This followed decades of outcry over flawed actuarial formulas used during the 1990s transition, which severely short-changed thousands of public servants on their retirement savings.

​The Task Team's final findings and recommendations are now before Parliament. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: Durban refugees to be provided with temporary accommodation
recentItems.description:
Refugees camping outside the Department of Home Affairs offices on Che Guevara Road in Durban will finally be provided with temporary accommodation. 

eThekwini Mayor Cyril Xaba made the announcement after visiting the area, following a protest by the anti-immigration group March and March. The refugees will be transported to temporary accommodation at the Lindela Repatriation Centre in Gauteng. 

For more on this, we are now joined by SABC News Reporter Mlondi Radebe.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: COSATU  | Delegates from 16 affiliate unions expected to vote for labour federation's leadership
recentItems.description:
COSATU's 15th National Congress will take place at a time when workers are grappling with the escalating cost of living, high inflation, and staggering unemployment rates.

1 800 delegates from 16 COSATU-affiliate unions are expected to vote for the labour federation's leadership at the congress, taking place in Midrand, Johannesburg. 

For more on this we cross live to our reporter Katlego Legodi.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.
